name: Priya — solid all round, but collapses are theory to her
summary: Around 150 hours with 35 or so thermic, flying two or three times a month on proper thermic days, centring climbs, working the brakes, launches reliably at the sites she knows. Her wing leaves her behind on glides. She knows exactly what she'd do in a collapse and has never practised any of it.
why_this_persona: The honest-middle case, and the persona that exercises this step's most distinctive Ready-blocker. One rung down, 'I know the theory but haven't practised' is explicitly treated as the skill being acquired during the step and cannot block anything. Here it blocks Ready, because Flybubble's guidance for this boundary asks for collapses, wingovers and spirals as regular practice by now. Her total, both category floors and the other nine checks all pass, so that single answer is doing all the work — which is precisely what a single-answer blocker is for.

notes: Computed skills 74.0, psychological 81.8, total 77.5, no bonus. The total clears the Ready threshold of 76 by about a point and a half, skills clears its floor of 70 by four, psychological clears 65 by seventeen — so the rule is genuinely the only thing holding her.

CROSS-STEP CHECK: a pilot running a low-B to high-B chain with this answer would be told, one screen earlier, that not having practised collapses is normal and expected at that rung, and then told here that it holds the result. That is correct and deliberate — the skill's status changes between the two steps, per knowledge/steps/low-b-to-mid-b.md ('gained during this step') and knowledge/steps/mid-b-to-high-b.md (Flybubble asking for regular proactive practice). The rule message names that difference explicitly so the pilot gets the reason rather than an apparent contradiction.
'collapse_practice' must NOT be a gate. She is held at Nearly ready, not capped at Not yet. A scorer that adds collapse_practice to the gates list will fail this persona.

'active_piloting_drill' must not fire: her answer is 'I work the brakes to keep the pressure even', which scores 0.7 here (down from 0.9 one rung below) but is still well above the blocker line and is not in that suggestion's trigger set. She gets 'phase_dependent_hands' instead, which is the refinement version. A scorer that reads the lowered score as a weak answer will fire the wrong suggestion.

Her thermic_airtime is 25_50, which scores 0.6 and passes the blocker, but 'build_thermic_hours' still fires — the suggestion deliberately covers the band below the ~50-hour figure as well as the two gated bands, because 'roughly 50' is where the sources land and she is under it.
'reserve_practice' must not fire: she has practised the throw once, which scores 0.85.
